scope: Offline reconstruction of the six existing hardware-profile trials; no replay, probe, wait strategy, renderer, algorithm or production changes; no new A/A or A/B.
counts_at_locked_snapshot: S=scheduled source frames by host timestamp; A=frames whose recorded pre-construction source timestamp has passed; E=latest actually enqueued sample; C=last completely acknowledged batch sample. S-C=(S-A)+(A-E)+(E-C). E-C includes up to one partially processed batch; real pending is separately exact.
enqueue_bounds: Recorded A timestamp is before construction and direct signal emission, not an enqueue timestamp. For nonfinal frame, synchronous DirectConnection implies enqueue no later than next frame preparation timestamp; tighten by first locked snapshot witnessing latest>=frame. Final frame uses first locked witness. No fabricated exact enqueue or completion events.
completion_bounds: Last snapshot acknowledging fewer than i and first snapshot acknowledging at least i bracket batch-boundary acknowledgement of i, not exact per-frame compute completion. Missing finer timestamps remain interval-censored.
camera_alignment: Native CSV elapsed is measured before Python callback and before disk writing, relative to unrecorded native record_start_wall. Bound its host origin between checked-frame preparation and armed_ns; show midpoint plus uncertainty and retain native-relative gap durations. No exact native/Python callback alignment claimed.
USB_alignment: Existing actual UsbWorker assembler receipt clock, not a timestamp of USB electrical arrival or native ReadDevice return.
focus_windows: Walking trial1 initial empty: planned start of sample48904 to planned start59904. Running trial2: host armed+7..14s, plus largest source-interval event. Other trials retain matching first-empty and whole-session summaries.
event_thresholds_descriptive_only: Source/USB/native-camera consecutive observation gaps >50ms; P sampler gaps >200ms. These describe gaps, do not estimate CPU usage, impose load eligibility, or gate comparisons.
native_evidence_decision: Existing timestamps can identify upstream and downstream backlog; they cannot retrospectively supply CPU/GIL/ready-to-run traces. Do not record new uncalibrated traces to attribute historical events. State remaining causal uncertainty and a prospective independently calibrated native-only protocol.
